response.sql: WITH product_metrics AS (SELECT p.product_id, pc.product_type_description, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_quantity, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) as order_item_count FROM Products p JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description), total_order_items AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM Order_Items), product_with_share AS (SELECT pm.product_id, pm.product_type_description, pm.avg_quantity, pm.order_item_count, CAST(pm.order_item_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / toi.total as share FROM product_metrics pm CROSS JOIN total_order_items toi), type_level AS (SELECT product_type_description, AVG(avg_quantity) as avg_qty_by_type, AVG(order_item_count) as avg_count_by_type, AVG(share) as avg_share_by_type FROM product_with_share GROUP BY product_type_description) SELECT AVG(avg_qty_by_type) as avg_product_quantity, AVG(avg_count_by_type) as avg_order_item_count, AVG(avg_share_by_type) as avg_share_of_items FROM type_level
